newsitem.title: USA: Labor Secretary to talk again to UPS, Teamsters.
newsitem.headline: Labor Secretary to talk again to UPS, Teamsters.

text.p: Labor Secretary Alexis Herman will have another round of contacts with officials from United Parcel Service and the striking Teamsters union on Wednesday, White House spokesman Mike McCurry said Tuesday.
"She expects another round of conversations tomorrow," McCurry told reporters aboard Air Force One on President Clinton's flight home from St. Louis.
He said Herman spent much of the flight continuing discussions on the phone with UPS officials and would probably talk to the Teamsters later in the day by phone.
McCurry also said Herman spent much of the day in St. Louis in contact with the parties in an effort to get them to reopen negotiations.
